articles.title: Global Markets Rally After Central Bank Announcement
articles.description: Stocks surged worldwide after the central bank signaled it would keep interest rates steady for the next quarter.
highlights: Major indices rose between 1% and 2% on optimism about economic growth.
Energy and tech sectors led the gains.
Analysts say investors are looking for clearer signs of inflation cooling.

articles.title: New Renewable Energy Plant Begins Operations
articles.description: A new solar farm has started producing clean energy, aiming to power 200,000 homes by the end of the year.
highlights: The facility spans over 500 acres and uses the latest photovoltaic panels.
It will reduce annual carbon emissions by an estimated 150,000 metric tons.
Local governments anticipate job growth from ongoing maintenance contracts.

articles.title: Tech Company Announces Cutting-Edge AI Tool
articles.description: A leading software firm unveiled a new AI assistant designed to help small businesses automate customer support.
highlights: The tool integrates with common messaging platforms and uses natural language understanding.
Early testers report a 40% reduction in response time to customer inquiries.
The company plans a phased rollout starting next month.
